Coverage_Description: Overseas-study travel protection (no excess): study interruption and tuition loss, emergency assistance and accident cover, baggage/travel document and personal liability benefits,
pricing: Semi-annual: Basic HK$1,080; Premier HK$1,890. Optional Medical Support add-on: Basic HK$1,200 / Premier HK$1,800 (total HK$2,280 / HK$3,690). Annual: Basic HK$1,800; Premier HK$2,500. Optional Medical Support add-on: Basic HK$2,000 / Premier HK$3,000 (total HK$3,800 / HK$5,500).
customer requirement: Insured person is an overseas student (at an overseas educational institution); trip must originate from Hong Kong
price structure: Basic or Premier plan; Semi-Annual (6-month, non-renewable) or Annual (renewable subject to underwriting)
additional informations: Coverage can be suspended once per policy year for up to 3 months; graduation incentive with up to 1-year post-graduation continuation on successful renewal; renewal No Claim Discount up to 20%
